shoreditch.name: Shoreditch
shoreditch.blurb: Home turf. Rents keep going up and nobody knows why.

city.name: The City
city.blurb: Every building is a bank, a firm, or both, and something older underneath.

greenwich.name: Greenwich
greenwich.blurb: The Meridian runs through it, which the locals will mention unprompted.

camden.name: Camden
camden.blurb: Markets, market stalls, and men who are technically also a market stall.

kingscross.name: King's Cross
kingscross.blurb: Everything in King's Cross is on its way somewhere else. Even the veins recharge faster.

battersea.name: Battersea
battersea.blurb: The power station stopped generating decades ago. Something still hums.

hampstead.name: Hampstead
hampstead.blurb: Old money and older trees. The Heath keeps its own counsel.

whitechapel.name: Whitechapel
whitechapel.special: vein NPC-raid chance ×1.5 (when vein raids land, M2)
whitechapel.blurb: The oldest grief in London, still paying rent to the newest landlords.

soho.name: Soho
soho.blurb: Nothing grows here. Everything gets sold here eventually.
